Known by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Yudrass''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He, along with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tritan]] asked an Imperial individual to find the [[Dorn Base|Imperial base's]] missing commander, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vannis]], as previous search parties had gone missing as well, and they wouldn't risk sending any more men. The individual eventually found Vannis' corpse inside a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Frostbite Redoubt|fortification]], reporting it afterwards to Tritan and Yudrass.
